newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two wheat ships expected in Rouen by December 18.
newsitem.headline: Two wheat ships expected in Rouen by December 18.

text.p: Two ships are expected in Rouen by December 18 to load some 45,000 tonnes of soft wheat, port officials said on Tuesday.
One vessel was also expected in Rouen by December 18 to load 54,000 tonnes of barley, they said
Destinations for the wheat and the barley were not specified.
In Rouen, six ships are currently loading a total of 127,000 tonnes of soft wheat destined for Cuba, Egypt, Eritera, Italy, and Morocco.
